verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Pipedream Connect handles OAuth/authorization flows and token storage/refresh automatically with no developer implementation required, credentials are encrypted at rest, requests proxied through Pipedream's servers (never exposing creds to models), and users can revoke access at any time. This directly matches the story's requirements for managed OAuth, encrypted vaulting, and automatic refresh. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of refresh behavior or encryption implementation beyond vendor docs.
